task.title: Randomized assessment form generation
task.objective: Close M2.05 with server-authoritative immutable randomized forms, permanent Worker-level stable-question non-repetition, exact question-version pinning, answer-safe delivery, Admin blueprint controls, database integrity enforcement, and exact-head browser/engineering evidence.

rejection.failed_criterion: A stable question must never be persisted more than once for the same Worker across different generated forms/cases, including concurrent generation.
verified_evidence: M2.05 targeted run 32121964032 failed on exact test commit 946ef2d8c4fcd9459645b595143eee6f600ce872.
The four pre-existing database integrity tests passed in the same run.
The new same-Worker/different-form stable-question repetition test failed with Missing expected rejection, proving the database accepted the second exposure.
Current service-side prior-exposure query cannot serialize two different case-generation transactions for the same Worker.
rejection.root_cause: Permanent Worker-level non-repetition exists as a read-before-write service rule but lacks a database uniqueness boundary keyed by Worker identity plus stable question identity. Different case transactions can race and both persist the same stable question.
rejection.required_correction_boundary: Keep generated assessment form items as the single exposure history; derive each item's Worker identity from its parent generated form inside the database, enforce unique Worker+stable-question persistence, and map resulting cross-case unique races to a safe generation error.
forbidden_patch_behavior: Do not weaken or remove the failing test.
Do not rely only on an in-process mutex or application lock.
Do not trust caller/browser supplied Worker identity on form items.
Do not introduce a second competing exposure-history source unless evidence proves the existing item history cannot safely own the invariant.
